description_for_human: Register a client public key, obtain one-time encrypted challenges, and read or write encrypted KV payloads without exposing plaintext to the AI.
description_for_model: CNothing AuthAI KV is a public MCP server for challenge-based AI-safe identity registration and encrypted KV storage. The AI must never request or handle private keys or decrypt envelopes. CRITICAL: recipient_public_key on kv_read must be the third-party service public key when that service will auth (e.g. Searchengine GET /v1/auth/public-key) — not CNothing AuthAI key. Do NOT save Searchengine authenticate_agent api_key_envelope (reader-encrypted) without backend decrypt. Read initialize instructions for common mistakes causing Failed to decrypt encrypted_key.

auth.instructions: Agent forwards opaque envelopes only. On kv_read, recipient_public_key is who decrypts the result — use third-party service public key for third-party auth. Never use get_authai_public_key as recipient_public_key for Searchengine credentials. Prefer client_uuid + auth_envelope per Searchengine search when no backend can decrypt kv_read results.

tools.name: get_authai_public_key
tools.description: Return the AuthAI public key metadata used by the trusted backend to encrypt auth, data, and query envelopes toward CNothing. Call this before registration or whenever the backend needs the active CNothing server key.

tools.name: authai_register
tools.description: Register a client public key and receive an encrypted one-time challenge for the client backend. The AI may relay challenge_for_client, but only the trusted backend should decrypt it.

client_public_key.description: PEM-encoded public key generated and held by the trusted backend.

client_key_alg.description: Optional key algorithm profile such as RSA-OAEP-256/A256GCM.

client_label.description: Optional human label for the client identity.

metadata.description: Optional non-secret metadata about the client.

tools.name: authai_refresh
tools.description: Consume a valid auth envelope and issue the next encrypted challenge for the client backend. Use this to continue a protected workflow without re-registering the client.

auth_envelope.description: Opaque auth envelope produced by the trusted backend.

tools.name: authai_key_holder_sign_challenge
tools.description: Recommended flow: create a signature-based key-holder challenge. The target signs challenge_text with its private key.

tools.name: authai_key_holder_verify_signature
tools.description: Recommended flow: verify signature proof with verification_id + challenge_text + signature + target_public_key.

challenge_text.description: Exact challenge text returned by authai_key_holder_sign_challenge.

signature.description: Base64 or base64url signature over challenge_text.

target_public_key.description: PEM-encoded target public key used for signature verification.

tools.name: authai_key_holder_challenge
tools.description: Compatibility flow: create a key-holder verification challenge pair using ciphertext compare. Prefer signature verification for new integrations.

target_public_key.description: PEM-encoded target public key to be verified.

metadata.description: Optional non-secret metadata for verification tracing.

tools.name: authai_key_holder_verify
tools.description: Compatibility flow: finalize verification by comparing responder_secret (S2) with S1 decrypted from challenge_for_authai.

verification_id.description: Verification challenge id returned by authai_key_holder_challenge.

responder_secret.description: S2 value from the target party after decrypting challenge_for_target.

challenge_for_authai.description: Ciphertext B encrypted with the CNothing public key.

tools.name: kv_save
tools.description: Save encrypted KV items. WRONG for Searchengine: saving authenticate_agent api_key_envelope (reader-encrypted) without backend decrypt. CORRECT: backend decrypts with reader private key, then stores plaintext JSON in data_envelope.

auth_envelope.description: Opaque action-bound auth envelope for kv.save.

data_envelope.description: Opaque ciphertext envelope containing the kv.save payload.

tools.name: kv_read
tools.description: Read encrypted KV items. recipient_public_key MUST be the decrypting party's PEM key — for Searchengine use GET /v1/auth/public-key, NOT get_authai_public_key. Wrong key → Failed to decrypt encrypted_key at Searchengine. Do NOT pass result_envelope_for_client to Searchengine search as api_key_envelope; backend extracts items[key] inner ksp1 after decrypt.

auth_envelope.description: Opaque action-bound auth envelope for kv.read.

query_envelope.description: Opaque ciphertext envelope containing the kv.read query.

recipient_public_key.description: Required. PEM of who decrypts the result. Third-party auth (Searchengine): that service public key from GET /v1/auth/public-key. NOT CNothing AuthAI key unless CNothing consumes the secret.
